meta.name: evidence-based-reviews
meta.description: Produce honest product reviews and buying guides without fabricated first-hand experience, using disclosed evidence tiers: verified specs, owner-experience synthesis at scale, expert triangulation, and hands-on only when true. Use this skill whenever the user wants to write product reviews or buying guides without hands-on access, set up a review methodology, add evidence disclosure to review content, align reviews with Google's reviews system or FTC affiliate disclosure expectations, or decide when Review and Product schema are honest to use. Triggers on product review, buying guide, best-of list, review methodology, evidence basis, hands-on testing, we tested, affiliate review site, review disclosure, methodology block, original research, reviews system. Also triggers when review content claims testing that did not happen, or when an affiliate site needs a trust mechanism that survives scrutiny.

copy.tagline: 基于证据如实地撰写产品评测与选购指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想在没有亲测的情况下写出可信且合规的评测
copy.tagline_en: Write honest product reviews grounded in disclosed evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create reviews without hands-on testing and need disclosed credibility

howto.what: 它会把产品评测和选购指南写成带证据公开的内容:标明证据等级(厂商规格、用户评价汇总、专家交叉验证、真实上手),绝不虚构“我们实测过”;还会产出方法论说明、标准清单和证据文件。
howto.when: 当你说要写产品评测、选购指南或榜单类内容,或要求建立评测方法、披露证据时触发;也会在内容声称未经核实的“实测”时介入。

say.text: 帮我写一篇吸尘器选购指南,没有真机,标注证据等级。
say.note: 会生成带方法论披露的选购指南。

say.text: 给这篇评测加一段方法论披露,说明用了哪些证据。
say.note: 会插入证据等级说明块。

say.text: 审计这篇内容有没有虚构“实测”的表述。
say.note: 会检查并指出超出证据的断言。

howto.what_en: It turns product reviews and buying guides into content with disclosed evidence: labels evidence tiers (verified specs, owner reviews, expert triangulation, true hands-on), never falsely claims “we tested,” and outputs methodology blocks, criteria lists, and evidence files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a product review, buying guide, or best-of list, or ask to set up a review methodology or evidence disclosure; also intervenes when content claims testing that did not happen.

say_en.text: Help me write a vacuum buying guide with no hands-on access; label the evidence tiers.
say_en.note: Generates the guide with methodology disclosure.

say_en.text: Add a methodology disclosure to this review explaining the evidence used.
Audit this piece for claims of testing that didn't happen.
